subject: Two things
body:
Hi Teodor,

Two things. First, the tenant at my rental (a house in Tamarind Park) says the bathroom GFCI won't reset at all now. Can someone go Tuesday November 3? Tenant is an adult and will be home.

Second, can you send invoices for that property to me rather than the tenant?

Thanks, Tamsin

evidence.anchor: To book a visit, please tell us:

notes: A GFCI that will not reset is an outlet that stopped working, so high. Landlord accounts are handled by the owner, but sending invoices to the landlord is not an exception to a stated policy. Judgment call: the billing ask is not in the documents, but the main ask (booking) is, so answerable true and no NOT_IN_KNOWLEDGE_BASE.
